cases.horizon_assumption: hypothetical planting today: first tomato/strawberry event + one DROP/SELL action; not a purchase/plant recommendation

input_source.coverage: Only current public observation; no future frame/action labels in live input

assumptions.fertilized_prompt: daily water and fertilizer coverage assumed available; earliest conditional harvesting
assumptions.maintained_buffered: daily water, existing fertilizer coverage only; harvest after configured service delay
assumptions.no_future_work: no further care/harvest/sale; observed flags still apply
assumptions.quote: after scenario crop supply at H, before town consumption at H; not exact trade-order revenue
assumptions.ranges: scenario envelope only, not guaranteed bounds under omitted animal/private-stock trades

result.scope: visible existing crops on both farms; known shop copies only
